annotations.title: Email address verification (syntax, MX, risk flags)

description: Checks an email address without sending mail: syntax rules (IDN domains in punycode and Unicode), MX records by preference, null MX (RFC 7505), implicit A/AAAA fallback, NXDOMAIN, SPF and DMARC policy, disposable, role, free-webmail and +tag flags, mail provider from MX hosts, and typo suggestions for popular domains. Returns a verdict and 0-100 score with reasons. Mailbox existence is not confirmed. Sources: Cloudflare DNS over HTTPS, disposable-email-domains (CC0). Price: $0.003 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

email.description: Email address to check, up to 512 characters (addresses over 254 octets are reported as invalid). A mailto: link (its ?query and #fragment dropped) or a Name <address> header form is unwrapped first. Inputs without an @, quoted local parts, IP-literal domains and mailto links with several addresses are rejected with 400 and not charged.
